The '''Cardset System''' was a code key [[Lock/Legends|lock]] designed to secure the entry hatch of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]], the system cost a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="PSG" />
